title: Fronted Topics and Clitic Pronouns
goal: Place a known object first as the topic with a matching clitic pronoun, and distinguish topic dislocation from contrastive focus.
grammar: clitic left dislocation (dislocación clítica) vs contrastive focus

items: I can front a known direct object as a topic with its matching clitic (*lo, la, los, las*).
I can front an indirect object with *le / les* and distinguish topic dislocation from contrastive focus.
I can use core debate terms for the moderator, rebuttal, turn to speak, approach and reasoning.
